holidays.name: National Vanilla Cupcake Day
holidays.description: Today is a good day to put down the fancy flavors and enjoy a plain vanilla cupcake. Fluffy cake and a swirl of buttercream are all you need. Bake a batch, buy one from a bakery, or sneak one out of the office break room.
holidays.origin: This is an unofficial observance of unclear origin. It has become a favorite on the calendar of sweet-themed food days.
holidays.funFact: Vanilla comes from the pods of an orchid. Vanilla is the only orchid that produces a widely used food flavoring, and each flower has to be hand-pollinated outside its native Mexico.

holidays.name: International Tongue Twister Day
holidays.description: This day is for twisting your tongue in knots. Try reciting phrases like 'red leather, yellow leather' as fast as you can, and challenge your friends to do the same. Expect plenty of giggles and some accidental nonsense words.
holidays.origin: This is an unofficial observance of unclear origin. It is a playful nod to the long tradition of word games and speech drills.
holidays.funFact: Speech coaches, actors, and broadcasters have long used tongue twisters as warm-ups to sharpen their diction before speaking in public.
